items.title: Mama's Sukuma Wiki 🌿
items.fact: Sukuma Wiki is a traditional Kenyan stew made with collard greens and rich in fibre.
items.activity: her home kitchen full of cultural details
narration: My joints ache on cold mornings, my dear. Stiffness is a challenge at our age.
So I do this: I chop one onion and two cloves of garlic. Then I heat some oil in a pan.
Next, I add the chopped onion and garlic to the pan and sauté until they're soft. Then I add a bunch of collard greens.
Finally, I season with salt and pepper to taste. Then I serve it with ugali or rice.
This traditional stew helps me feel warm and comforted on cold mornings. The fibre in the collard greens is also gentle on my stomach.
Try making Sukuma Wiki this week, my dear, and tell me in the comments how it turns out. You deserve a warm and comforting meal, and I'm proud of you for taking care of yourself.
items.description:
Learn how to make traditional Kenyan Sukuma Wiki, a hearty stew made with collard greens, onion, and garlic. The ingredients are simple: collard greens, onion, garlic, oil, salt, and pepper. Try making it this week and share in the comments how it turns out. Don't forget to subscribe for more recipes and tips from Mama Wanjiru!

items.title: Breathe Easy 🌟
items.fact: Deep breathing reduces stress and improves oxygen flow to the body.
items.activity: a park bench with a friend
narration: I feel stressed when visitors come, my dear. Some mornings I wake up feeling anxious too.
So I do this: sit comfortably and breathe in deeply. I inhale for a count of four.
Next, I hold my breath for a count of four. This helps slow down my heart rate.
Then, I exhale slowly for a count of four. This releases tension from my body.
Deep breathing helps me relax and improves my overall well-being, it's very helpful. It's a simple habit that works.
Try deep breathing tomorrow, my friends, and tell me how you feel, you deserve to feel calm. Remember to ask your doctor about any personal health concerns.
items.description:
Abuelita shares her simple yet effective deep breathing technique to reduce stress and improve oxygen flow. Try it out and see how it can benefit you. Share in the comments how deep breathing works for you. Don't forget to consult your doctor for personal health advice.
